ex.en: The new software is not compatible with older operating systems.
ex.zh: 这款新软件与旧操作系统不兼容。

words.note: compatible 多与 with 连用；作「合得来」解时也接 with sb。

ex.en: The company offers a cash bonus as an incentive to work harder.
ex.zh: 公司提供现金奖金，激励员工更努力工作。

words.note: incentive 后常接 to do 或 for 短语。

ex.en: The film won praise from critics but failed at the box office.
ex.zh: 这部电影获得影评人称赞，但票房惨败。

words.note: critic 指批评者本人；criticism 指批评，critical 是形容词。

ex.en: Preliminary results suggest that the treatment is safe and effective.
ex.zh: 初步结果表明这种治疗安全有效。

words.note: pre 表「前」，preliminary 指正式行动前的初步阶段。

ex.en: Lack of funding remains the biggest obstacle to the project.
ex.zh: 资金不足仍是该项目最大的障碍。

words.note: obstacle 后接 to 加名词或动名词。

ex.en: She is a lawyer by profession but writes poetry in her spare time.
ex.zh: 她职业是律师，业余时间写诗。

words.note: profession 指需专门训练的行业，比 job 正式。

ex.en: The delivery van broke down halfway, so the parcels arrived late.
ex.zh: 送货车半路抛锚，所以包裹到得很晚。

words.note: van 指厢式货车或面包车；lorry 是英式大卡车，truck 为美式。

ex.en: I felt dizzy after standing up too quickly in the hot room.
ex.zh: 在闷热的房间里站起太快，我感到头晕。

words.note: feel dizzy 是「感到头晕」，dizzy 为形容词。

ex.en: The boy bears a striking resemblance to his grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个男孩和他祖父长得极为相似。

words.note: 动词 resemble 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 to。

ex.en: She showed exceptional talent for languages at an early age.
ex.zh: 她从小就表现出非凡的语言天赋。

words.note: exceptional 兼有「极好」与「例外」两义，看语境判断。

ex.en: Women now constitute nearly half of the students in this department.
ex.zh: 女性如今占该系学生的近一半。

words.note: constitute 是及物动词，直接接宾语；表「由…组成」用 consist of。

ex.en: She still cherishes the letters her grandmother wrote to her.
ex.zh: 她仍珍藏着祖母写给她的那些信。

words.note: cherish 既指珍惜感情、记忆，也指怀有希望或想法。

ex.en: There is a clear discrepancy between the two reports of the accident.
ex.zh: 关于这起事故的两份报告存在明显出入。

words.note: discrepancy 指数据或说法对不上，常与 between、in 搭配。

ex.en: The course attracts students from a broad spectrum of backgrounds.
ex.zh: 这门课程吸引背景各异的学生。

words.note: spectrum 表「范围」时用 a spectrum of；复数为 spectra。

ex.en: The evidence finally convinced him that he had been wrong.
ex.zh: 证据终于使他确信自己错了。

words.note: convince 后接 of 短语或 that 从句。

ex.en: Modern medicine can prolong life but cannot always improve its quality.
ex.zh: 现代医学能延长寿命，却未必能提高生命质量。

words.note: prolong 常含「不必要地拖长」意味，中性延长多用 extend。

ex.en: The missionary spent thirty years teaching and building schools in the region.
ex.zh: 这位传教士在该地区教书建校三十年。

words.note: 源自 mission（使命），missionary 指受派遣传教的人。

ex.en: The company may terminate the contract if the work is not finished on time.
ex.zh: 如果工程未按时完工，公司可以终止合同。

words.note: terminate 比 end 正式，多用于合同、雇佣关系；名词 termination。

ex.en: A faulty valve caused the water to leak into the basement.
ex.zh: 一个故障阀门导致水漏进了地下室。

words.note: valve 指控制流体的阀门，也指心脏瓣膜，注意与 tube 区分。

ex.en: If the goods are damaged, you can ask for a full refund.
ex.zh: 如果商品有损坏，你可以要求全额退款。

words.note: 名词读 /ˈriːfʌnd/，动词读 /rɪˈfʌnd/，重音位置不同。

ex.en: The remnants of the old city wall can still be seen today.
ex.zh: 老城墙的残迹至今仍能看到。

words.note: 多用复数 remnants，指残存部分；形容词 remaining 表「剩下的」。

ex.en: The report is for internal use only and must not be shared outside.
ex.zh: 这份报告仅供内部使用，不得外传。

words.note: internal 与 external（外部的）相对。

ex.en: Her essays on literary criticism are widely read by college students.
ex.zh: 她的文学批评文章被大学生广泛阅读。

words.note: literary 与 literal（字面的）、literate（识字的）易混，注意区分。

ex.en: He grew up listening to classical music but now plays jazz.
ex.zh: 他听着古典音乐长大，如今却演奏爵士乐。

words.note: classical 指古希腊罗马传统或古典音乐；classic 指经典、一流的。

ex.en: Members enjoy the privilege of using the library after midnight.
ex.zh: 会员享有午夜后使用图书馆的特权。

words.note: privilege 是可数名词，常与 of doing 连用。

ex.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
ex.zh: 在这个食谱里你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

words.note: substitute A for B 是用 A 换掉 B，方向不能颠倒。

ex.en: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first house.
ex.zh: 他们办了三十年期的抵押贷款买第一套房。

words.note: mortgage 常与 pay off、take out 搭配。

ex.en: Firefighters worked all night to control the blaze in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 消防员整夜奋战以控制仓库的大火。

words.note: blaze 指大火或强光；in a blaze of glory 表「辉煌地」。

ex.en: The rent is high; moreover, the flat is far from the station.
ex.zh: 房租很高，而且这套公寓离车站很远。

words.note: moreover 用于句首，后加逗号，比 also 正式，多用于书面论证。

ex.en: The wind scattered the leaves all over the garden.
ex.zh: 风把树叶吹散到花园各处。

words.note: scatter 强调向四处散开；be scattered across 表「散布在…」。
